items: 【Compatible Fit & Important Notice】 Deepace roof rack cross bars are designed specifically for 2024 2025 2026 Hyundai Santa Fe and Hyundai Santa Fe Hybrid models equipped with RAISED side roof rails. Compatible with SEL, XRT, Limited, and Calligraphy trims. NOT compatible with SE trim or bare-roof models without side rails.

【Lockable & Heavy-Duty – 330 lbs Load Capacity】 Lockable crossbars feature an all-aluminum base and aluminum cross bars (end caps are ABS only), delivering exceptional strength while keeping weight low. Built with dual internal reinforcement ribs inside each bar for enhanced structural stability, these cargo bars safely support up to 330 lbs. Ideal for cargo boxes, rooftop carriers, bikes, kayaks, canoes, snowboards and camping gear.

【Upgraded Dual-Screw Clamping for Extra Stability】 Each mounting base uses two reinforced bolts instead of traditional single-bolt designs, creating a tighter clamp on the side rails. The reinforced structure keeps your roof luggage rack securely in place, minimizing shake and wind movement even on long highway drives. Travel with confidence on family vacations and road trips.

【Quiet Ride & Rail Protection】 The aerodynamic tube design reduces wind resistance and road noise for a smoother, quieter ride. Rubber pads create a tight fit while protecting your factory rails from scratches, and plastic-dipped contact brackets add extra protection to your roof rack system. With reduced wind noise during everyday driving, your cabin stays peaceful—perfect for kids resting in the back, family conversations, or enjoying music on the road.

【Strong Tie-Down, Adjustable Spacing】 Dual aluminum trapezoidal tie-down loops on each bar end provide secure anchor points for straps, adding extra stability to your rooftop cargo rack while driving. The adjustable crossbar length allows you to tailor the spacing to match various rooftop loads, from cargo boxes to camping gear.

【Easy Install & 2-Year Warranty】 This complete roof rack crossbar kit includes front and rear bars with clear labels, mounting hardware, and step-by-step instructions for hassle-free installation. Backed by a 2-year warranty for added confidence and long-term peace of mind.
